Sources: NATM Trailer Manufacturer Directory (550 members, all 46 pages, category filters), NHTSA vPIC name searches (956 trailer makers in the 21 states), vPIC x OSHA 2025 cross-match, south Georgia OSHA rows and EPA FRS city sweep, EPA FRS by name. 11 new base records, 0 excluded; screen file ledger/audit/tr-screen-P.json (841 rows). Flags: (1) Moritz Mansfield (T15) and Landoll Waterville (T18) were earlier leads (TR-F, TR-A), built here on new NATM site-level evidence. (2) C&B: company and NATM give Caldwell (factory contacts page); EPA FRS registers Wilder (23365 Peckham Rd); which site fabricates is not stated. (3) Leads where NATM names the trailer type at the site (T18) but T17 rests on the NATM listing (plus EPA FRS) only: Forest River Cargo #700 Woodway TX (EPA FRS at the address; Oct 2024 release says Texas cargo manufacturing continues), Merritt Henderson CO, Texline Sulphur Springs, Ware Cargo/Wells Cargo South Waycross, Anvil Douglas: is a current association listing a "current site-level source" under T17? (4) Delco Brookston: high-volume line with robotic welding stated (rule 3 boundary); welder_postings is a Welding department on the company apply form (apply-form precedent for the coordinator). (5) Platinum prospect pass (low confidence) rests on a company welding statement and a single manufacturing address. (6) OSHA quotes cannot be re-fetched (osha.gov blocked); Bear Trailer quotes are browser-render only (each confirmed with --browser --check).
